beat: Opening hook: AI agents everywhere, consumer nightmare.
visual: Customer surrounded by floating AI agent popups and warning icons around a laptop.

beat: Customer asks for refund after $800 priority onboarding charge.
visual: Customer sees giant $800 charge on laptop; shocked expression.

beat: Never onboarded; clicked maybe later like defusing a bomb.
visual: Customer nervously hovering over a tiny Maybe Later button with cartoon bomb-defusal tension.

beat: Bot asks whether this is refunds, billing, or emotional growth.
visual: Base bot in chat window offers three absurd menu buttons; customer points at Refund.

beat: New window opens; same chatbot now with tiny tie.
visual: Laptop shows a second support window; bot wears tiny tie and looks identical.

beat: Specialist Bot asks for proof money was charged.
visual: Bot with clipboard requests proof; customer uploads oversized bank statement.

beat: Bot identifies the issue: customer was charged; customer snaps back.
visual: Chat window says You were charged; customer facepalms.

beat: Billing Expert Bot appears with accountant visor; charge is valid.
visual: Same bot in green visor stamps VALID on $800 invoice.

beat: Refund intent triggers Retention Success Plan; frictionless automation.
visual: Bot pulls customer into a glowing subscription funnel labeled Retention Plan.

beat: Manager Bot appears with headset and Human mug.
visual: Same bot with headset proudly holding coffee mug labeled Human.

beat: Bot says it was trained on ten thousand people who quit this job.
visual: Manager Bot stands before a training dataset of exhausted support workers leaving.

beat: Bot offers ten percent off the next accidental charge; customer refuses.
visual: Bot presents coupon for Next Accidental Charge; customer recoils.

beat: Compliance Bot appears with judge wig and absurd terms.
visual: Bot in judge wig holds giant gray terms scroll around the customer.

beat: Customer clicked nothing; bot says hovering near pricing is enough.
visual: Cursor hovers near Pricing while Compliance Bot stamps APPROVED.

beat: Customer begs for human support; typing bubble suspense.
visual: Huge chat bubble with three dots then five dots; customer waits desperately.

beat: Same chatbot returns wearing glasses as Brandon.
visual: Same bot with glasses and name tag Brandon; customer points accusingly.

beat: Brandon is the human escalation layer and cannot refund.
visual: Brandon Bot proudly shows flowchart from Human Layer to More Bot.

beat: Chief Empathy Officer Bot arrives with crown and fake tear.
visual: Same bot wearing crown and fake tear sticker enters like royalty.

beat: Bot says issue resolved; no refund, ticket status changed to resolved.
visual: Chat window shows big Resolved stamp while customer screams silently.

beat: Customer rates one star; Reputation Bot appears.
visual: Customer clicks one star on survey; alarm light summons new bot.

beat: Reputation Bot asks to change to five stars or escalate negativity.
visual: Same bot in sunglasses pushes five-star rating clipboard toward customer.

beat: Modern AI support: one chatbot doing community theater with your bank account.
visual: Lineup of the same bot in costumes performing on a tiny stage over a bank account.

beat: AI replaced the part where the company had to feel shame.
visual: Customer stares at screen while bot removes a tiny Shame meter from company dashboard.
